acceptedAnswer.text: CounterCtrl Cloud reads your overnight POS transaction data, compares every location, category and item against last week and last year, and hands your team the handful of numbers that actually need attention.

Store managers, department managers, customer service, pricing coordinators and receiving/DSD staff in the store; marketing, sales, pricing, store operations and loss prevention at the office. Everyone works from the same nightly load, scoped to what their role covers.

mainEntity.name: How is it different from a standard POS report?

acceptedAnswer.text: CounterCtrl does not go live until its numbers reconcile against the reports your team already trusts. You set what "off" looks like, and every location, category and item is graded against that threshold rather than listed in full.
